parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore company that owns the project. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore project. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/projects. Identifies which project's currency configuration to act on.

get.description: Returns the currency configuration for the specified project. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404.

schema.title: Project Currency Configuration GET Response
schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore project. When no configuration has been created yet, currency-related fields are returned as null while company-eligibility and toggle defaults are still populated, so consumers can detect the unconfigured state without a 404.

company_id.description: Procore company ID that owns this project. Matches the {company_id} path parameter.

project_id.description: Procore project ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all project-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the project's currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). May differ from the company base currency when company-level multicurrency is enabled. Null when no project currency configuration has been created.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered for this project. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD). Null when no project currency configuration has been created.

company_currency_exchange_rate_override.description: Decimal override (sent as a string for precision) that supersedes the company-level exchange rate when converting between the project currency and the company base currency. Null to use the company exchange rate.

currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update.description: Whether the project's `currency_iso_code` can still be changed. Currently always returns true; will reflect exchange-rate / multicurrency-record presence once project exchange-rate APIs are GA.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency settings apply to this project's financial objects. Defaults to false. When true, financial objects can use a different currency from the company base. Requires the parent company to also have multicurrency enabled.

eligible_for_financial_objs_multicurrenc.description: Whether the parent company satisfies the prerequisites (e.g., ERP integration compatibility) to apply project-level multicurrency to financial objects. When false, attempts to enable `multicurrency_enabled` on the project will be rejected. Conditionally present — absent from the response for companies that do not have project-level financial-object multicurrency rolled out.

multicurrency_phase_two_flag_enabled.description: Inherited from the parent company. Indicates whether the project has access to the extended multicurrency capabilities (separate base/quote currency tracking and per-record exchange rate fields used by multicurrency-aware downstream resources). When false, the project is limited to baseline multicurrency behavior and attempts to set `multicurrency_enabled=true` on the project are rejected.

post.description: Creates a project currency configuration. Requires the parent company to have multicurrency enabled, otherwise the API returns 400. The project currency may differ from the company base currency. Returns 400 if a configuration already exists for the project.

currency_iso_code.description:
ISO 4217 three-letter code for the project's currency (e.g., 'EUR'). Required.
May differ from the company base currency when company-level multicurrency is enabled.
Check `currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update` in the GET response before attempting
to update — if false, this field is locked and the request returns 400.

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether to apply project-level currency settings to this project's financial objects. Defaults to false. Requires the parent company to also have multicurrency enabled; otherwise the API returns 400.

Only updatable while `currency_iso_code_eligible_for_update` is true in the GET
